content: markdown-exec 1.12.3 (released July 2026, Python >=3.10). Key features: exec code blocks in MkDocs/Markdown via pymdownx.superfences; Python blocks execute in isolated globals with patched print; source='tabbed-left'/'above'/'console' options show source alongside output; html='1' lets blocks emit raw HTML (used for inline SVG figures); configured as MkDocs plugin in mkdocs.yml under plugins: - markdown-exec. The project already uses this correctly with docs_fig.py emitting SVG via print(render(f)).
